Drop keyword search and only do prefix matching.
Push all filtering to the client side.

q: 为 FB 帖子搜索定义需求时，哪些属于核心功能需求？（多选）
q_en: When defining requirements for FB Post Search, which are core functional requirements?
options: 用户能创建和点赞帖子
用户能按关键词搜索帖子
搜索结果能按时间或点赞数排序
搜索结果按用户兴趣做个性化排序
why: 核心需求只有三条：创建/点赞、关键词搜索、按时间或赞数排序；个性化被明确划出范围，这个决定让后面的缓存设计大为简化。
why_en: The core requirements are creating and liking posts, keyword search, and sorting by recency or like count, while personalization is explicitly out of scope.
options_en: Users can create and like posts.
Users can search posts by keyword.
Results can be sorted by recency or like count.
Results are personalized to each user's interests.

q: FB 帖子搜索里，下列哪些被划为范围外（out of scope）？（多选）
q_en: In FB Post Search, which items are out of scope?
options: 模糊匹配（搜 bird 命中 ostrich）
隐私规则与过滤
新帖 1 分钟内可被搜索
搜索页对新帖做实时推送更新
why: 模糊匹配、个性化、隐私、复杂相关性排序、多媒体、实时更新都在范围外；「新帖 1 分钟内可搜」恰恰是核心非功能需求，不是范围外。
why_en: Fuzzy matching, privacy filters, and realtime result updates are out of scope, whereas making new posts searchable within a minute is a core requirement.
options_en: Fuzzy matching (searching bird also matches ostrich).
Privacy rules and filtering.
New posts searchable within one minute.
Realtime push updates to the search page.

scenario: 明确需求阶段，你在考虑是否把「搜索结果个性化」留在范围内，这个决定将影响后续架构的复杂度。
scenario_en: During requirements clarification, you are deciding whether personalized search results are in scope, which will drive downstream architecture complexity.
q: 把个性化划出范围，对系统设计最大的红利是什么？
q_en: What is the biggest system-design benefit of making personalization out of scope?
options: 数据库可以少建一个索引
不再需要 API 网关
相同查询人人同结果，查询级缓存极其有效
写入路径可以完全省掉
why: 没有个性化意味着搜索结果只取决于查询本身、人人相同，结果可以进缓存和 CDN 被海量复用；所以值得当面问「个性化是不是硬需求」。
why_en: Dropping personalization means identical queries return identical results for everyone, which makes query-level caching and CDN reuse dramatically more effective.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品硬性要求千人千面的搜索结果，查询级缓存基本失效，只能退到缓存更底层的索引数据、在线上做个性化重排。
options_en: The database needs one fewer index.
You no longer need an API gateway.
Identical queries return identical results, so query-level caching becomes extremely effective.
The write path can be dropped entirely.
tradeoff: 无个性化换来缓存高复用 vs 千人千面的相关性

why: 这两个数不是算出来的容量结果，而是面试中先约定的用户体验目标。真正的计算发生在后面：用它们倒推索引、缓存、冷热分层和写入流水线。
why_en: The five-hundred-millisecond and one-minute numbers are service targets, not derived constants, and they constrain the query path and freshness path.

q: 「老帖、冷门帖也要可搜索，但允许更慢」这条需求在为哪个设计决策埋伏笔？
q_en: Which later design decision is hinted by the requirement that old and unpopular posts are searchable but slower?
options: 放弃高可用目标
冷热分层：热数据进内存、冷数据下沉廉价存储
换一台更大的单机数据库
把所有索引都搬进 CDN
why: 大数据量系统天然有热/冷数据之分：热数据高频访问要内存级速度，冷数据低频访问可放磁盘、远端库甚至磁带；这条 NFR 正是后面「冷索引下沉 S3」的伏笔。
why_en: Allowing old or unpopular posts to be slower foreshadows a hot-cold split where hot data lives in memory and cold data moves to cheaper, slower storage.
options_en: Abandon the high-availability goal.
A hot-cold split: hot data in memory, cold data on cheaper storage.
Switch to a single bigger database machine.
Move all indexes into the CDN.

q: 补全写入侧的规模估算（10 亿用户，每天按约 10 万秒取整）：
q_en: Fill in the write-side scale estimate for 1B users and roughly 100K seconds per day.
text: 每人每天 1 帖 → 约 {{10k}} posts/秒；每人每天 10 个赞 → 约 {{100k}} likes/秒；点赞写入量是发帖的 {{10}} 倍。
why: 用 1B ÷ 100k 秒的快捷除法得出发帖 10k/s、点赞 100k/s；点赞比发帖多一个数量级，这个观察直接决定了后面必须重点优化点赞写入。
why_en: A billion users produce roughly ten thousand posts and one hundred thousand likes per second, so likes outnumber post creations ten to one.
scenario: 规模估算：10 亿用户，每天约 10 万秒，估算写入侧的量级。

q: 由这个读规模，读路径最该具备的能力是？
q_en: Given this read scale, what capability does the read path need most?
options: 读会突发到 10 倍，重复查询要能被缓存/CDN 吸收
读量极小，单台机器就足以承载全部流量
读远大于写，就该牺牲写路径来保读

why_en: Search reads run about ten thousand per second but can spike tenfold, so the read path leans on result caching and a CDN to absorb bursts.
scenario: 10 亿用户、每人每天约 1 次搜索，读流量还可能突发到平时的 10 倍以上。

Read volume is tiny; a single machine can carry all traffic.
Reads dominate writes, so sacrifice the write path to protect reads.

q: 对比估算结果（写约 110k/s vs 搜索 10k/s），关于系统性质最重要的结论是？
q_en: Comparing about 110K writes/s with 10K searches/s, what is the key system takeaway?
options: 系统读多写少，应重点优化读路径

q: 这个存储量级对搜索系统提出的设计要求是？
q_en: What does this storage scale force the search system to do?
options: 内存放不下 3.6PB，索引要设上限、冷数据下沉便宜存储
数据量不大，一台大内存机器即可
把全部帖子原文都塞进 Redis 加速
存储不是问题，无需特别处理

why_en: Ten years of a billion posts a day is about 3.6 petabytes, far too much to keep in memory, which forces index caps and cold blob storage.
scenario: FB 运营 10 年、每天约 10 亿帖、每帖元数据约 1kb，原始存储估算约 3.6 PB。
scenario_en: After 10 years at roughly 1B posts per day and 1 KB metadata per post, raw storage is about 3.6 PB.
options_en: 3.6 PB won't fit in memory, so indexes must be capped and cold data pushed to cheap storage.
The data is small; one big-memory machine is enough.
Stuff every post's full text into Redis for speed.

q: 对全表扫描方案做分片/复制（M 个节点各扫 N/M 帖），结论是？

q: 交集之后为什么还要「拉原文验证短语」这一步？

为了顺便统计点赞数

To warm up the cache.

q: 交集法与 bigram 索引处理短语查询，核心权衡的维度是？

查询计算成本 vs 索引存储成本
一致性 vs 分区容忍性
两者没有实质区别

why_en: Intersection pays at query time with expensive transfers and set operations, while bigrams pay upfront with a much larger index for instant phrase lookups.
